description: This file defines an abstract Java class 'AbstractCliClient' which serves as a base class for CLI clients within the Eclipse Hono project. It manages Vertx instances, context, and Spring environment profiles, including dependency injection methods.

classes.name: AbstractCliClient
classes.description: An abstract base class for CLI modules in the Eclipse Hono project, managing Vertx and Spring environment profiles.

methods.name: setActiveProfiles
methods.description: Sets the active Spring profiles from the Environment, ensuring the environment is not null.

methods.name: setVertx
methods.description: Sets the Vertx instance and initializes the associated context, ensuring the Vertx object is not null.
